question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

When my mother makes a promise, she always ________ it.
solution:
The correct answer is '**keeps**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate word for the given blank is '**keeps**'.
 
• We know that '**promises**' are '**kept**'.
 
• It means that '**keep**' is the most contextual word with '**promise**'.
 
• **To** **keep promise** means 'to do what one said one would definitely do (किसी ने जो कहा वह करने के लिए निश्चित रूप से करेंगे)'.
 
 
• *Example: Her boss cannot **keep** the **promise** he made about a pay rise.*
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 2.**

 

**Correct Sentence:__*** When my mother makes a promise, she always **keeps** it.*
